I genuinely prefer deep, focused conversations on a single topic. Jumping between subjects can be fun and energetic—kind of like a good brainstorm—but it often stays on the surface. 

When you stay with one idea, you get to actually unpack the assumptions behind it, explore the weird nuances, and see where the thought really leads. It feels much more rewarding to build something substantial together than to just skim across a dozen different things. 

What about you? Do you like to dive deep, or do you prefer keeping things fast-paced and varied?
